english.description: It seems you share my love of all that is bizarre. You recovered the Samoan necklace, well done!
english.name: ach_name_1

english.description: You would make a highly efficient criminal.
english.name: ach_name_2

english.description: Your morals don't improve!
english.name: ach_name_3

english.description: The beautiful, faithful nature of dogs!
english.name: ach_name_4

english.description: With your usual happy mixture of cunning and audacity, you recovered all that was stolen!
english.name: ach_name_5

english.description: See the value of imagination!
english.name: ach_name_6

english.description: You have never failed to play the game!
english.name: ach_name_7

english.description: I was sure that I might rely on you.  You found all the items from my past adventures.
english.name: ach_name_8

english.description: The Press is a most valuable institution – if you only know how to use it!
english.name: ach_name_9

english.description: You have a turn for both observation and deduction!
english.name: ach_name_10

english.description: You handled that with less than your usual – that is to say, you handled it well. You found the key!
english.name: ach_name_11

english.description: Your nerves are fairly proof!
english.name: ach_name_12

english.description: There are always some lunatics about. It would be a dull world without them.
english.name: ach_name_13

english.description: The one fixed point in a changing age.
english.name: ach_name_14

english.description: I never get your limits... there are unexplored possibilities about you.
english.name: ach_name_15

english.description: There are in you the makings of a very fine loafer.
english.name: ach_name_16

english.description: Moonshine is a brighter thing than fog, but this is a pea-souper! You asked for Help a great deal.
english.name: ach_name_17

english.description: It was the bisulphate of baryta!
english.name: ach_name_18

english.description: A trusty comrade is always of use. Well done. And yet one got away...
english.name: ach_name_19

english.description: I have a great deal of respect for your judgement.  You opened the safe room!
english.name: ach_name_20

english.description: I would have made an actor – and a rare one. You deduced my disguise.
english.name: ach_name_21

english.description: An isolated phenomenon? A brain without a heart? I trust that you did not judge me so quickly!
english.name: ach_name_22

english.description: I can see that you are a force to be reckoned with.
english.name: ach_name_23

english.description: To a great mind, nothing is little.  You completed the first deduction board.
english.name: ach_name_24

english.description: Genius is an infinite capacity for taking pains. Bravo!
english.name: ach_name_25

english.description: With all respect for your natural acumen, you handled that very well. You opened the safe box!
english.name: ach_name_26

english.description: You are a conductor of light!  You discovered the hidden code.
english.name: ach_name_27

english.description: The most winning woman I ever knew was hanged for poisoning. But I digress. You found the letter!
english.name: ach_name_28

english.description: You never can resist a touch of the dramatic!
english.name: ach_name_29

english.description: A simple trick, but exceedingly effective!
english.name: ach_name_30

english.description: I must compliment you exceedingly upon the zeal and the intelligence which you have shown.
english.name: ach_name_31

english.description: One's ideas must be as broad as Nature if they are to interpret Nature. Well done!
english.name: ach_name_32

schinese.description: 看来你和我一样喜欢所有奇怪的东西。 你找回了萨摩亚项链， 干得好!
schinese.name: ach_name_1

schinese.description: 你具备成为一名高效罪犯的潜质 。
schinese.name: ach_name_2

schinese.description: 你还是这幅德行！
schinese.name: ach_name_3

schinese.description: 小狗美好又忠诚的天性！
schinese.name: ach_name_4

schinese.description: 凭着你的智勇双全， 所有被盗的东西都找回来了！
schinese.name: ach_name_5

schinese.description: 看， 这就是想象的价值！
schinese.name: ach_name_6

schinese.description: 你从没失手过！
schinese.name: ach_name_7

schinese.description: 我相信我可以依靠你。 你找到了我过去冒险的所有物品。
schinese.name: ach_name_8

schinese.description: 如果你知道如何利用的话， 那么报社就是最有价值的机构！
schinese.name: ach_name_9

schinese.description: 轮到你来观察推理了！
schinese.name: ach_name_10

schinese.description: 你做得可比以前来得轻松。 你找到了钥匙!
schinese.name: ach_name_11

schinese.description: 你真是处变不惊！
schinese.name: ach_name_12

schinese.description: 世界上总有些疯子。 没有他们的世界将是多么乏味。
schinese.name: ach_name_13

schinese.description: 万变中的不变。
schinese.name: ach_name_14

schinese.description: 我不知道你的极限在哪…… 不过你的身上有着许多未知的可能性。
schinese.name: ach_name_15

schinese.description: 你还真有做懒汉的潜质。
schinese.name: ach_name_16

schinese.description: 雾虽遮不住明亮的月光， 但这场黄色的浓雾可不容小觑！ 你总是在寻求帮助。
schinese.name: ach_name_17

schinese.description: 是硫酸钡！
schinese.name: ach_name_18

schinese.description: 做得好， 一位可靠的伙伴总能帮得上忙。 但还是有一个人逃走了……
schinese.name: ach_name_19

schinese.description: 我非常尊重你的判断。 你打开了保险室！
schinese.name: ach_name_20

schinese.description: 我本来可以成为一名演员， 一位不可多得的演员。 你识破了我的伪装。
schinese.name: ach_name_21

schinese.description: 一位孤独的奇才？ 只动脑不走心？ 我不相信你这么快就对我下结论！
schinese.name: ach_name_22

schinese.description: 我看得出来你身上有种不可忽视的力量。
schinese.name: ach_name_23

schinese.description: 对智者来说， 世事无小事。 你完成了第一个推理任务。
schinese.name: ach_name_24

schinese.description: 天才总能负重前行。 好样的!
schinese.name: ach_name_25

schinese.description: 做得好， 你的敏锐令人钦佩。 你打开了保险箱！
schinese.name: ach_name_26

schinese.description: 你真让人醍醐灌顶！ 你发现了隐藏的密码。
schinese.name: ach_name_27

schinese.description: 我认识的最迷人的女人因为下毒被绞死了。 话说回来， 你找到了那封信！
schinese.name: ach_name_28

schinese.description: 你无法拒绝戏剧性的一刻！
schinese.name: ach_name_29

schinese.description: 一个简单的小把戏， 但十分奏效。
schinese.name: ach_name_30

schinese.description: 你表现出了非凡的热忱和才智， 我佩服得五体投地。
schinese.name: ach_name_31

schinese.description: 如果想要破译自然的奥秘， 一个人的思想就必须跟自然一样开阔。 做得好！
schinese.name: ach_name_32
